fields.summary_ko.0: Mizuho raised Amazon (AMZN) price target from $330 to $335 while maintaining 'Outperform' rating, suggesting AWS could achieve 40% annual growth rate over the next 2 years.
fields.summary_ko.1: Amazon plans approximately $220B in capital expenditures for 2026 and expects further increases in 2027, with AI inference demand and open-source model adoption serving as key growth drivers.
